mechanism: Chloroquine inhibits warfarin metabolism via CYP2C9 and CYP3A4, increasing warfarin levels and anticoagulant effect; additionally, chloroquine has inherent antiplatelet and anticoagulant properties that potentiate bleeding risk.
action: Monitor INR closely and increase monitoring frequency when chloroquine is initiated or discontinued; adjust warfarin dose as needed to maintain therapeutic INR; consider alternative antimalarial if possible.
